speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The symptoms of grunting, retractions, and increased respiratory rate in a newborn are classic signs of alveolar collapse seen in RDS, not Tuberculosis. I will now request a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms typical of this condition. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray. REQUEST IMAGES.
